claims.statement: If s3(A)>=1 and ||A-diag(A)||op<=7/16, then X^TAX has an essentially bounded density with norm at most 2 sqrt(2) pi for all independent marginal densities <=1.

If s2(H)<=1/8 with H=A-diag(A), then either a definite physical two-coordinate branch gives density <=4 pi, or there are opposite heavy diagonals >=7/8, all other diagonals <1/7, H=lambda vv^T+R with ||R||<=1/8, |lambda|>41/56, max v_i^2<7/41, and outside normalized aggregate coefficients <7/27.

In the unresolved one-effective branch, the actual full matrix A compressed to span(e_p,e_q,w), where w is the normalized outside part of the dominant H eigenvector, has smallest singular value >9/280.
Convert the uniformly nondegenerate mixed coordinate/aggregate three-plane into a universal small-ball bound without conditioning away the outside product-bank provenance.
